'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Geoff Dearing LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' LS Sucka's
* '''Username:''' gdearing
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
